correctness.rationale: In \(A=(\bigoplus_{n\ge1}M_n(\mathbb C))_{\ell_\infty}\), the element \(a=(J_n)\) has spectrum exactly \(\overline{\mathbb D}\): outside the disk the geometric resolvents are uniformly bounded, while for \(0<|\lambda|<1\) their norms grow at least as \(|\lambda|^{-n}\) and on \(|\lambda|=1\) at least as \(\sqrt n\). Von Neumann's inequality gives the polynomial-norm upper bound and finite-support comparison with the unilateral shift gives equality. Liu–Shen's published realization of arbitrary countable \(\ell_\infty\)-sums of finite-dimensional unital Banach algebras transports these identities to a Calkin algebra. The first \(r\) coordinates are killed by the \(r\)-th power, so each finite detector is nilpotent.
